entries.clue: Long night in a parked car with cold coffee, watching the door
Spiny grazer that chews with an 'Aristotle's lantern'
Dealer who asks no questions about where the jewellery came from
Woolly head-hugger favoured by bank robbers and mountaineers alike
Ear-splitting AWOOGA! horn beloved of old cartoons and emergency drills.
Slitherer whose 'electric' namesake is actually a knifefish
Crew member watching the street, whistle at the ready
Arctic 'unicorn' whose spiral horn is really a tooth
Iron persuader for windows and crates that won't open politely
Box that screeched and warbled for half a minute before letting you online.
Reef-builder's handiwork, or a pinkish hue
Hot kitchen cupboard that pings when the roast demands to come out.
Dashboard direction-giver that bongs, then coldly announces 'Recalculating'.
Hole in the wall that beeps in a panic until you remember to take your card.
